description: This file defines the 'Translation' model class responsible for retrieving translation records from the database in an OpenCart project. It includes a method 'getTranslations' that fetches all translation entries for a given route, based on store and language IDs.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Model class for handling translation data, extending the base system model.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Retrieves all translation records for a specific route, filtered by store and language IDs.
